visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a middle-aged Asian man wearing a white T-shirt and a thick brown fleece bathrobe, standing in a brightly lit bathroom with white tiled walls. He holds a black comb and looks into the mirror with a surprised expression, his eyes wide and mouth slightly open as he prepares to style his flat hair. (2) He reaches for a round purple container of hair styling wax, opening the lid with his hands. He scoops a pea-sized amount of white product onto his fingertip, showing it to the camera before rubbing his palms together vigorously to emulsify the wax, ensuring his hands are fully coated. (3) With the wax applied to his hands, he begins styling his hair by raking his fingers through the strands and lifting the roots on top. His movements are fast and rhythmic, transitioning from broad strokes to detailed finger-combing to create texture and volume, while his facial expressions remain focused. (4) After achieving the desired shape, he picks up a tall, metallic gold Gatsby hairspray bottle. He holds the can at an angle and sprays several bursts around his head to lock the style in place. The fine mist is briefly visible against the bathroom's bright overhead lighting. (5) To conclude the demonstration, the man checks his reflection from the side and front, smiling confidently. He gestures with both thumbs up towards the camera to signal success, showing off his now-textured and neatly styled hair against the clean, minimalist bathroom background.
